{{Top|leg}}
'''Krakin''' was an individual who established the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[Krakin's Alehouse]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a number of individuals claimed that Krakin had been a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]], or a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]].

==Behind the scenes==
Krakin was created by [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]] and received a brief mention in ''[[Remember When]]'', an article that was added to [[Wizards.com]] in [[2005]] as part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign.
